Go down a hole in {wiki:Shadowthorn}, the elven city near Venore, and clear a large room full of elves, {creature:Ghoul|Ghouls} and a {creature:Demon Skeleton}. At the far north of the room, three quest boxes give you a {item:Time Ring}, an {item:Elven Amulet} and a {item:Crystal Ball}.
to climb back up through the hole
Health potions; runes or ammo for fighting at range

As a team: a knight with lots of health and {item:Health Potion|Health Potions} runs around with the monsters behind him, while the paladins shoot {item:Bolt|bolts} and {item:Heavy Magic Missile Rune|HMMs} at the {creature:Demon Skeleton|Demon Skeletons} and the mages use {item:Sudden Death Rune|SDs} on the {creature:Elf Arcanist|Elf Arcanists}.
If you are a mage or a paladin, stay on the ramp and pull the monsters slowly, one at a time: the room is big and the monsters are spread out.

Start from **Venore** and leave the city through the **east exit**. Cross the swamps **south-east** to the elven camp of {wiki:Shadowthorn} (the map shows the fastest route). A {item:Machete} and a {item:Shovel} help you get through the swamp.
Fastest route from Venore (east exit) to Shadowthorn
Inside {wiki:Shadowthorn} (use the {item:Machete} to cut the vegetation along the way), enter the marked hole.
Down there, head **west** to the ramp that goes down into the big room.
Map: from the hole west to the room and the chests in the north
2. Clear the room and open the boxes

At the bottom of the ramp there are **4 {creature:Elf Arcanist|Elf Arcanists}**, at least **4 {creature:Elf Scout|Elf Scouts}**, **2 {creature:Ghoul|Ghouls}** and **1 {creature:Demon Skeleton}**. Pull them slowly from the ramp and kill them.
Every now and then {creature:Dharalion}, a rare elven boss, shows up in the area.
The **three quest chests** are at the far **north** end of the room. Open them.
Time Ring, Elven Amulet and Crystal Ball

Go back the same way: climb the ramp, head **east** to where you fell through the hole and climb up with the {item:Rope} ({coord:33060,32182,7}). Then leave Shadowthorn and cross the swamps **north-west** back to the east exit of **Venore**.
